android.desc:
Indic Keyboard is the first Android keyboard for Indian languages, now rebuilt from the ground up. Type in your language anywhere you would type in English: messages, email, search and more.

- 31 languages, 96 layouts, 21 scripts
- Gesture typing, even on transliteration layouts - a first for any keyboard
- Companion typing: type your language from the English keyboard, no switching
- Predictive transliteration: type "namaste", get नमस्ते
- Next-word prediction in 20 languages, spell check
- Clipboard history and password manager autofill
- Physical keyboard support
- Material You themes, emoji search
- Free and open source. No ads, no tracking.

What languages are supported?

- Arabic Keyboard (العربية)
- Assamese Keyboard (অসমীয়া) - Inscript, Transliteration, Phonetic, Predictive Transliteration
- Bengali Keyboard (বাংলা) - Probhat, Inscript, Avro, Predictive Transliteration
- Bhojpuri Keyboard (भोजपुरी) - Inscript, Kaithi
- Burmese Keyboard (မြန်မာ)
- English
- Gujarati Keyboard (ગુજરાતી) - Phonetic, Inscript, Transliteration, Predictive Transliteration
- Hindi Keyboard (हिन्दी) - Inscript, Soni, Transliteration, Compact, Predictive Transliteration
- Ho Keyboard (𑢹𑣉𑣉 𑣎𑣋𑣜) - Warang Citi
- Kannada Keyboard (ಕನ್ನಡ) - KaGaPa, Inscript, Compact, Inscript Mobile, Transliteration, Predictive Transliteration
- Kashmiri Keyboard (کٲشُر) - Transliteration, Inscript, Sharada
- Konkani Keyboard (कोंकणी) - Inscript
- Maithili Keyboard (मैथिली) - Kaithi, Inscript
- Malayalam Keyboard (മലയാളം) - Lalitha, Compact, Inscript, Poorna Inscript, Mobile Inscript, Transliteration, Swanalekha, Predictive Transliteration
- Manipuri Keyboard (মৈতৈলোন্) - Meetei Mayek, Inscript
- Marathi Keyboard (मराठी) - Inscript, Transliteration, Phonetic, Predictive Transliteration
- Mon Keyboard (ဘာသာ မန်)
- Nepali Keyboard (नेपाली) - Romanized, Traditional, Transliteration, Inscript, Predictive Transliteration
- Odia Keyboard (ଓଡ଼ିଆ) - Inscript, Transliteration, Lekhani, Phonetic, Predictive Transliteration
- Punjabi Keyboard (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ) - Phonetic, Inscript, Jhelum, Transliteration, Predictive Transliteration
- Rohingya Keyboard (𐴌𐴟𐴇𐴝𐴙𐴚𐴒𐴙𐴝) - Hanifi Rohingya
- Sanskrit Keyboard (संस्कृतम्) - Transliteration, Predictive Transliteration
- Santali Keyboard (ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ) - Inscript, Ol Chiki, Ol Chiki Compact
- Saurashtra Keyboard (ꢱꣃꢬꢵꢰ꣄ꢜ꣄ꢬ)
- Sindhi Keyboard (सिन्धी) - Inscript
- Sinhala Keyboard (සිංහල) - Singlish, Wijesekara
- Sylheti Keyboard (ꠍꠤꠟꠐꠤ) - S
